scope: The 19 catalog records with unresolved release dates at baseline f8c5aa5a7a6395cbce0d562461acad81ed148191. This is a targeted date audit, not a search for all new releases.

This establishes availability by that day, materially earlier than the prior catalog date, but the documentation addition does not say the model was launched that day. No primary source establishing its initial launch date was located; later dated alias targets remain distinct.

results.name: Dracarys Llama 3.1 70B Instruct
results.evidence: Verified release month August 2024. Original checkpoint publication starts August 14; public interaction on the exact model exists August 16. The founder's August 22 announcement is later. These establish the month without inventing which day between initial upload and external access was the first public release.

results.name: Qwen Max
results.evidence: Alibaba’s October 31, 2023 launch announcement says Tongyi Qianwen 2.0 is now public through web/app and developer APIs. The original Qwen repository README revision of November 30 explicitly identifies qwen-max as that newly released Tongyi Qianwen 2.0 API model. Together these primary sources establish the original Max release; the later 0403 and January 2025 backing snapshots do not date the alias launch.

results.name: Qwen MT Plus
results.evidence: Alibaba Cloud Bailian’s official December 2024 product newsletter lists qwen-mt-turbo and qwen-mt-plus as newly launched multilingual translation models. It was posted January 2, 2025 but explicitly covers December 2024 releases. The source supports month precision only. July 22/24, 2025 are the later Qwen3 upgrade dates.
